ideas.idea: Add Bakery/LocalBusiness JSON-LD to the home page
ideas.why: Accurate that none exists, but the site's no-JSON-LD choice is not a required fix and the benefit is modest.

ideas.idea: State address, opening hours and how to pre-order as text on the home page
ideas.why: The home page mentions pre-ordering but gives no address, hours or method, so people and machines can't find this.

ideas.idea: List all loaves on the breads page with days and prices, optionally individual pages
ideas.why: The page claims over twenty loaves but names only two, so listing them gives readers and crawlers real content.

ideas.idea: Add concrete class details (dates, price, size, booking route), optionally Event markup
ideas.why: The classes page says to book early but gives no dates, price or booking route.

ideas.idea: Add in-content links between Breads, Classes and ordering
ideas.why: Nav links already reach every page, so extra in-content links add little.
Accurate since lastmod is missing, but the effect on a three-URL site is minimal.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image)
ideas.why: They're missing, but this applies to almost any site and mainly affects link previews.

ideas.idea: Add 'York' to the breads and classes page titles
ideas.why: Those titles omit the location the home page includes, and local relevance matters for a York bakery.

ideas.idea: Remove the redundant noindex plus robots disallow on /members/
ideas.why: The report itself calls it harmless and deliberate, and the brief says /members being noindex and disallowed is correct.
